notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Decoction Module.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Decoction Module.
Repeat from step 2.
